hook.name: HookenToken
hook.description: An ERC-404 hybrid token that is also its own Uniswap v4 hook. In afterSwap, it takes a 4% fee on exact-output swaps: on sells, 1% goes to a creator royalty and 3% is distributed as ETH dividends to token holders; on buys, the fee accrues to the creator as tokens. Each swap also feeds an on-chain evolution engine that advances NFT life stages based on cumulative volume and triggers mutation events on sharp price moves.
